subject: Vatican City
note: Hand-curated research for a Geographica episode about Vatican City. Claims are cited to a pinned Wikipedia revision (trusted_secondary).

claims.text: With an area of 44 hectares and a population of about 882 in 2024, Vatican City is the smallest country in the world both by area and by population.
It is an enclave within the city of Rome, Italy, and the administrative centre of the Catholic Church.
It is the only country in the world with a population of fewer than 1,000 people.
As an enclave within Italy, its military defence is provided by the Italian Armed Forces; it has no armed forces of its own, although the Swiss Guard is a military corps of the Holy See.

rome.note: Rome, the city that surrounds Vatican City.
